title: XYUV wire EDM: auto-detect cap and wall faces from a solid and derive 4-axis sync points

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Detect the two cap faces of a ruled solid automatically and derive 4-axis wire sync points from the connecting wall edges.

## Context

Today `crates/app/src/operation/wire_ruled.rs` requires two picked flat profiles on the top and bottom planes, plus manual `WirePairing::SyncPoints` for twisted parts.
Two outlines alone do not distinguish a cylinder from a hyperboloid, or a spur gear from a skew gear.
Alex's 2026-11-21 design note on `#2690` observes that the two uncut cap faces on a wire-cuttable solid have the highest edge adjacency and near-opposite normals, and that the remaining faces form the ruled walls.

## What this does

- Add a cap-face detector over `FeatureGraph` (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs`) that finds the two planar faces with the highest loop-edge adjacency and near-opposite normals (`dot <= -0.999`).
- Refuse ambiguous solids (for example zero or more than two matching cap pairs, or non-parallel caps) by name instead of guessing.
- Trace wall crease and boundary edges connecting vertices of the upper cap loop to vertices of the lower cap loop to build ordered `WireSync` pairs (`crates/app/src/operation/wire_ruled.rs`).
- Keep manual face, edge-chain, and sync-point selection as an explicit override.
- Route the extracted profiles and derived sync points through `wire_contour_ruled` so the shipped `#2693` and `#2694` swallowtail healers apply unchanged.

## Done means:

- A twisted ruled solid (such as a skew gear or twisted prism) auto-detects its upper and lower cap profiles and derives ordered `WireSync` anchors without manual sync input.
- The generated 4-axis wire path passes `folds`, `crossing`, `lean_law`, `clearance`, and `sim::verify::wire`.
- Ambiguous solids and non-ruled walls refuse by name, and manual profile and sync overrides keep working.

Part of #2690
